landing.headline: Are you looking for someone affected by the disaster?
landing.subheadline: Submit verified information in under 2 minutes. Information is instantly clustered, prioritized, and transmitted to NDRF and local rescue teams.
landing.reportMissingDesc: Submit details of a stranded, missing, or uncontacted loved one.
landing.iNeedHelpDesc: Share your location and situation if you are stranded or trapped.
landing.imSafeDesc: Confirm your safety to ease family panic and rescue queues.
landing.preDisasterPrompt: Heading into high-risk alpine or flood corridors?
landing.preDisasterAction: Register group entry & generate QR Emergency ID Card →

report.title: Missing Person Intake Report
report.aiAssistDesc: Have a frantic WhatsApp message or voice transcript? Paste it here to auto-fill the form fields automatically.
report.aiAssistPlaceholder: e.g. 'My uncle Ramesh (60) wearing yellow raincoat near bridge around 2pm. He has severe asthma and was with a tour group from Pune.'
report.medicalAlertPlaceholder: e.g. Severe asthma, insulin dependent, cardiac patient
report.lastSeenPlaceholder: e.g. Bhotekoshi Bridge X, Border Camp 3
report.groupType: Was this person travelling with anyone?
report.groupNamePlaceholder: e.g. Pilgrim Trail Group 17, Himalayan Safaris
report.docOcrSubtitle: Have your loved one's Aadhaar card, bus ticket, yatra permit, or hotel slip? Upload or select a document to instantly extract details and auto-fill the report.
report.ocrUploadDesc: Upload bus ticket, trek permit, or hotel receipt to extract passenger list and match against existing database records.
report.consentText: I confirm that this report is submitted in good faith for emergency rescue and humanitarian tracking.
report.saveNotice: Save this Case ID. Responders have been notified and prioritized according to urgency factors.
